calculation_handling.description: An expansion of a lawfully existing school must comply with Section 150.48 and the zone requirements; schools are not a modelled building type.
calculation_handling.gaps: School buildings are outside the building types the tool models.

units.disclosure: Expansions or additions to a lawfully existing public or private school must comply with Section 150.48 and the zone requirements. The tool does not evaluate school buildings.

calculation_handling.description: A lawfully existing school may be replaced with a new school building that complies with Section 150.48 and the zone requirements; schools are not a modelled building type.
calculation_handling.gaps: School buildings are outside the building types the tool models.

units.disclosure: A lawfully existing public or private school may be replaced with a new school building that complies with Section 150.48 and the zone requirements. The tool does not evaluate school buildings.

10.5.20.1(1).explanation: A lawfully existing public or private school in the Residential Zone category is permitted. Any expansion, or a replacement building, must comply with Section 150.48 and the requirements of the zone.
